name: ES_v_Todo
sql_definition:
create view ES_v_Todo
as
select isNull(acl._del,0) as _del,isNull(acl.CanWatchWfProc,0) as CanWatchWfProc,u.RtId,u.RtName,u.TaskId,u.TaskName,u.WiId,u.RcId,u.PiId,u.WiType,u.State,u.WiDesc,u.DlDate,u.UserId,u.UserLogin
,u.UserName,u.PrevWiId,u.CreDate,u.IfReadOnly,u.CanReturn,u.IsFirst,u.State1,u.RemindText
from
(
select t.RtId,rt.RtName,TaskId=t.TId,TaskName=t.TName, WiId=wi.WiId,RcId=wi.RcId,PiId=wi.PiId,WiType=wi.WiType,wi.State
,WiDesc=wi.WiDesc,wi.DlDate,UserId=x.UserId,u.UserLogin,u.UserName
,link.PrevWiId
,wi.CreDate,t.IfReadOnly,t.CanReturn,wi.IsFirst,wi.State1,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(500), wi.remindText) as RemindText
from ES_WorkItem wi, ES_WiTodo x, ES_WfTask t, ES_Tmp rt,ES_User u,ES_WiLink link
where t.TType<=2 and wi.State=0 and t.DelFlag=0
and wi.WiId=x.WiId
and wi.TId=t.TId
and t.RtId=rt.RtId
and x.UserId=u.UserId and u.AccState=0
and wi.WiId=link.WiId
and exists (select 1 from ES_RepCase rep where rep.RcId = wi.RcId)
union
select t.RtId,rt.RtName,TaskId=t.TId,TaskName=t.TName, WiId=wi.WiId,RcId=wi.RcId,PiId=wi.PiId,WiType=wi.WiType,wi.State
,WiDesc=wi.WiDesc,wi.DlDate,UserId=x.UserId,u.UserLogin,u.UserName
,PrevWiId=''
,wi.CreDate,t.IfReadOnly,t.CanReturn,wi.IsFirst,wi.State1,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(500), wi.remindText) as RemindText
from ES_WorkItem wi, ES_WiTodo x, ES_WfTask t, ES_Tmp rt,ES_User u
where t.TType<=2 and wi.State=0 and t.DelFlag=0
and wi.WiId=x.WiId
and wi.TId=t.TId
and t.RtId=rt.RtId
and x.UserId=u.UserId and u.AccState=0
and wi.IsFirst=2
and exists (select 1 from ES_RepCase rep where rep.RcId = wi.RcId)
) u left join (select max(d) as _del,max(CanWatchWfProc) as CanWatchWfProc,rtId,userId from ES_v_TmpAclUser group by rtId,userId) acl on u.rtId=acl.rtId and u.userId=acl.userId
go

name: 增补可选取工序
sql_definition:
create view [增补可选取工序] as SELECT
  m.[并行标志],
  m.[最大流水工序号] AS [流水工序号],
  m.[零件编号],
  b.[U8生产编号],
  b.[U8零件编号],
  b.工序号,
  b.[工序名称],
  b.[工序名称编号],
  b.工序工时明细主键,
  b.生产编号,
  b.零组件名称,
  b.零组件图号,
  b.投产数量,
  b.项目机型,
  b.制造大纲编号,
  b.制造大纲版次 
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      a.零件编号,
      a.[并行标志],
      MAX ( a.[流水工序号] ) AS 最大流水工序号 
    FROM
      [dbo].[生产工序信息_主表] a 
    WHERE
      a.[并行标志] <> ''
      AND a.[工序状态] not IN('取消','已完成') AND a.流转卡类型<>'临时增补流转卡'
    GROUP BY
      a.零件编号,
      a.[并行标志] 
  ) m
  LEFT JOIN [生产工序信息_主表] b ON m.零件编号 = b.[零件编号] 
  AND m.[最大流水工序号] = b.[流水工序号] UNION
SELECT
  c.[并行标志],
  c.[流水工序号],
  c.[零件编号],
  c.[U8生产编号],
  c.[U8零件编号],
  c.工序号,
  c.[工序名称],
  c.[工序名称编号],
  c.工序工时明细主键,
  c.生产编号,
  c.零组件名称,
  c.零组件图号,
  c.投产数量,
  c.项目机型,
  c.制造大纲编号,
  c.制造大纲版次 
FROM
  [生产工序信息_主表] c 
WHERE
  c.[并行标志] = ''
  AND c.[工序状态] not IN('取消','已完成') AND c.流转卡类型<>'临时增补流转卡'

name: 流程卡最大或者最小工序过检信息
sql_definition:
create view [流程卡最大或者最小工序过检信息] as WITH PartMinMaxStep AS (
    SELECT
        零件编号,
        MIN([流水工序号]) AS 最小工序号,
        MAX([流水工序号]) AS 最大工序号
    FROM
        [dbo].[生产工序信息_主表] 
    WHERE
        [工序状态] NOT IN ('取消','报废') 
    GROUP BY
        零件编号
)
SELECT
    t1.零件编号,
    -- 直接从最小工序表获取零件基础信息
    minStep.[零组件图号],
    minStep.[零组件名称],
    minStep.[类别质量编号],
    t1.最小工序号,
    minStep.[工序状态] AS 最小工序状态,
    minStep.检验日期 AS 最小工序检验日期,
    t1.最大工序号,
    maxStep.[工序状态] AS 最大工序状态,
    maxStep.检验日期 AS 最大工序检验日期
FROM PartMinMaxStep t1
-- 关联最小工序
INNER JOIN [dbo].[生产工序信息_主表] minStep
    ON t1.零件编号 = minStep.零件编号 
    AND t1.最小工序号 = minStep.[流水工序号]
    AND minStep.[工序状态] NOT IN ('取消','报废')
   
-- 关联最大工序
INNER JOIN [dbo].[生产工序信息_主表] maxStep
    ON t1.零件编号 = maxStep.零件编号 
    AND t1.最大工序号 = maxStep.[流水工序号]
    AND maxStep.[工序状态] NOT IN ('取消','报废')
;

CREATE  view Caq_RealCostBomBody
as

---材料
select PCoid=aw.cppid, Parent=C.ipartid,cVerID=ip.cverid,Ver.cVerName,Cppid='P'+convert(nvarchar(40),aw.camoid),PartID=aw.cAmoID,    --母件信息
       InvCode = v.InvCode,InvName = v.InvName,InvAddCode = v.InvAddCode,InvStd = v.InvStd,
       UnitName = ComUnitName,
       InvAttr = enum.enumname,
       LeadTime = v.LeadTime,InvFree_1=p.Free1,InvFree_2=p.Free2,
       InvFree_3=p.Free3,InvFree_4=p.Free4,InvFree_5=p.Free5,  InvFree_6=p.Free6,InvFree_7=p.Free7,
       InvFree_8=p.Free8,InvFree_9=p.Free9,InvFree_10=p.Free10,  InvDefine_1=v.InvDefine1,
       InvDefine_2=v.InvDefine2,InvDefine_3=v.InvDefine3,InvDefine_4=v.InvDefine4,

       InvDefine_8=v.InvDefine8,  InvDefine_9=v.InvDefine9,InvDefine_10=v.InvDefine10,
       InvDefine_11=v.InvDefine11,InvDefine_12=v.InvDefine12, InvDefine_13=v.InvDefine13,
       InvDefine_14=v.InvDefine14,InvDefine_15=v.InvDefine15,InvDefine_16=v.InvDefine16
       ,aw.iQua as Quan,IP.iInvRCost as InvCost,cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as LaborWh,cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as LaborCost,
       cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as cAssWh,cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as cAssCost, cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as ManuWh, cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as ManuCost,
       cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as OtherCost, cast(NUll as decimal(38,12)) as SemiCost,
       IP.iInvRCost as UnitCost,
       aw.iQua*IP.iInvRCost as TotalCost
  from Ca_COPlan C
               inner join ca_awpc aw on aw.cppid=C.iPlanCoid and aw.camotype=0
               inner join ca_invprice IP on aw.cAmoID =ip.ipartid and aw.cVerID=ip.cVerID
        inner join caq_baspart P on P.partid=aw.camoid
        inner join v_bas_inventory V on V.InvCode=P.invcode
        inner join ca_version Ver on Ver.cverid= ip.cverid
	left  join v_aa_enum enum on enum.enumtype='MM.PartType'  and  enum.enumcode=v.InvAttr

union ALL
--耗用半成品
select  distinct PCoid=A.pcoid,Parent=A.Parent,cVerID=A.cverid,Ver.cVerName,Cppid=cast(A.iplancoid as nvarchar(20)),PartID=A.ipartID,
       InvCode = v.InvCode,InvName = v.InvName,InvAddCode = v.InvAddCode,InvStd = v.InvStd,
       UnitName = v.ComUnitName,
       InvAttr = enum.enumname,
       LeadTime = v.LeadTime,InvFree_1=p.Free1,InvFree_2=p.Free2,
       InvFree_3=p.Free3,InvFree_4=p.Free4,InvFree_5=p.Free5,  InvFree_6=p.Free6,InvFree_7=p.Free7,
       InvFree_8=p.Free8,InvFree_9=p.Free9,InvFree_10=p.Free10,  InvDefine_1=v.InvDefine1,
       InvDefine_2=v.InvDefine2,InvDefine_3=v.InvDefine3,InvDefine_4=v.InvDefine4,
       InvDefine_5=v.InvDefine5,InvDefine_6=v.InvDefine6,InvDefine_7=v.InvDefine7,
       InvDefine_8=v.InvDefine8,  InvDefine_9=v.InvDefine9,InvDefine_10=v.InvDefine10,
       InvDefine_11=v.InvDefine11,InvDefine_12=v.InvDefine12, InvDefine_13=v.InvDefine13,
       InvDefine_14=v.InvDefine14,InvDefine_15=v.InvDefine15,InvDefine_16=v.InvDefine16
       ,iqua as Quan,MatAmo as InvCost,
       case when v.InvAttr<>2 then LabQua else null end as LaborWh,case when v.InvAttr<>2 then LabAmo else null end as LaborCost,  --纯委外只有材料费和加工费
       case when v.InvAttr<>2 then AssQua  else null end as cAssWh,case when v.InvAttr<>2 then AssAmo else null end as cAssCost,
       case when v.InvAttr<>2 then ManuQua else null end as ManuWh,case when v.InvAttr<>2 then ManuAmo else null end as ManuCost,
       case when v.InvAttr<>2 then OtherAmo else OutsourAmo end as OtherCost,SemiAmo as SemiCost,
       case when v.InvAttr<>2 then (MatAmo+LabAmo+AssAmo+ManuAmo+OtherAmo+SemiAmo) else (MatAmo+OutsourAmo+SemiAmo) end as UnitCost,
       case when v.InvAttr<>2 then (MatAmo+LabAmo+AssAmo+ManuAmo+OtherAmo+SemiAmo)*A.iqua else (MatAmo+OutsourAmo+SemiAmo)*A.iqua end as TotalCost
       from
        (select C.iplancoid as pcoid,C.ipartid as parent,D.iplancoid,D.ipartid,aw.cVerid,aw.iqua,
        sum(case when awc.camotype=0 then awc.iqua else 0 end) MatQua,sum(case when awc.camotype=0 then awc.iqua*ca_invprice.iInvRCost else 0 end) MatAmo,
        sum(case when awc.camotype=1 then awc.iqua else 0 end) LabQua, sum(case when awc.camotype=1 then (case isnull(E.iDirMethod,1) when 1 then isnull(F.iPlanMauAmoRat,0) when 2 then  isnull(F.iPlanMauAmoRat,0) when 3 then  isnull(G.iPlanMauAmoRat,0) else 0 end) * awc.iQua else 0 end) as LabAmo,
        sum(case when awc.camotype=2 then awc.iqua else 0 end) AssQua,sum(case when awc.camotype=2 then awc.iqua*ass.iplanprice else 0 end) AssAmo,
        sum(case when awc.camotype=3 then awc.iqua else 0 end) ManuQua,sum(case when awc.camotype=3 then isnull(F2.iPlanMauAmoRat,0) * Awc.iQua else 0 end) ManuAmo,
        sum(case when awc.camotype=4 then awc.iqua else 0 end) OtherQua,sum(case when awc.camotype=4 then Awc.iAmo else 0 end) OtherAmo,
        sum(case when awc.camotype=6 then awc.iqua else 0 end) OutsourQua,sum(case when awc.camotype=6 then Awc.iAmo else 0 end) OutsourAmo,
        sum(case when awc.camotype=5 then awc.iqua else 0 end) SemiQua,sum(case when awc.camotype=5 then Awc.iqua*pc.ipdtunitamo else 0 end) SemiAmo
        --,*

        from Ca_COPlan C
         inner join ca_awpc aw on aw.cppid=C.iPlanCoid and aw.camotype=5
         inner join Ca_COPlan D on  aw.camoid=D.iplancoid
         inner join ca_awpc awc on awc.cppid=D.iplancoid and aw.cverid=awc.cverid
         left join ca_invprice on awc.cAmoID =ca_invprice.ipartid and awc.cVerID=ca_invprice.cVerID and awc.camotype=0   --材料费
         left join Ca_PerCostMode E on Aw.cVerID=E.cVerID     --人工费
         left join CA_DepPMA F on F.cdeptid = D.cdeptid and Aw.cVerID=F.cVerID and Awc.cAmoType=F.cAmoType and Awc.cAmoType=1   --人工费
         left join CA_ProPMA G on Awc.camoid = G.cProcedureID and Aw.cVerID=G.cVerID  and Awc.cAmoType=1 --人工费
         left join ca_assmp ass on awc.cAmoID=ass.cAuxAmoID and awc.cVerID=ass.cVerID  and awc.camotype=2    --辅助费用
         left join CA_DepPMA F2 on F2.cdeptid = D.cdeptid and Aw.cVerID=F2.cVerID and Awc.cAmoType=F2.cAmoType and Awc.cAmoID=F2.cAmoID and Awc.cAmoType=3   --制造费
         left Join (select cppid,cverid,sum(ipdtunitamo) as ipdtunitamo from ca_planc group by cppid,cverid) pc on pc.cVerid=aw.cverid and awc.camoid=cast(pc.cppid as nvarchar(40)) and awc.camotype=5 and awc.iqua<>0
  group by C.iplancoid,C.ipartid,D.iplancoid,D.ipartid,aw.cVerid,aw.iqua
        ) A
        left join ca_version Ver on A.cverid=ver.cverid
        inner join caq_baspart P on P.partid=A.ipartid
        inner join v_bas_inventory V on V.InvCode=P.invcode
	left  join v_aa_enum enum on enum.enumtype='MM.PartType'  and  enum.enumcode=v.InvAttr

h.BomId,

c.cComUnitName,--计量单位        
c.cComunitCode,

    -- 使用数量不考虑存货属性“BOM展开单位”设置为辅助计量单位的情况，因为外部系统没有这个规则
    -- 当子件为固定用量时，等于"基本用量/ 基础数量*（1+子件损耗率）"；
    -- 当子件为变动用量时，等于"基本用量/基础数量*（1+子件损耗率）/（1-母件损耗率）"。
    ,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(PDM.fvflag, 1) = 0 
           THEN PDM.baseqtyn/PDM.baseqtyd*(1+PDM.compscrap/100) 
           ElSE PDM.baseqtyn/PDM.baseqtyd*(1+PDM.compscrap/100)/(1-PDM.parentscrap/100) 
      END) AS dqty
    ,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(PDM.fvflag, 1) = 0 
           THEN PDM.u_auxbaseqtyn/PDM.baseqtyd*(1+PDM.compscrap/100) 
           ElSE PDM.u_auxbaseqtyn/PDM.baseqtyd*(1+PDM.compscrap/100)/(1-PDM.parentscrap/100) 
      END) AS dauxqty      
    ,PDM.mutexrule,PDM.whcode,PDM.drawdeptcode
    ,PDM.u_auxunitcode,PDM.u_changerate,PDM.u_auxbaseqtyn,PDM.u_producttype
    ,PDM.u_define22,PDM.u_define23,PDM.u_define24,PDM.u_define25,PDM.u_define26
    ,PDM.u_define27,PDM.u_define28,PDM.u_define29,PDM.u_define30,PDM.u_define31
    ,PDM.u_define32,PDM.u_define33,PDM.u_define34,PDM.u_define35,PDM.u_define36
    ,PDM.u_define37,PDM.bomid,PDM.implog,PDM.u_versionhandle,PDM.regcode,PDM.icheck
    ,PDM.iimporttype,PDM.isel 
    ,InvP.cInvAddCode AS invaddcode,InvP.cInvName AS invname,InvP.cInvStd AS invstd
    ,InvP.cComUnitCode AS invunit,InvP.cInvDefine1 AS invdefine_1
    ,InvP.cInvDefine2 AS invdefine_2,InvP.cInvDefine3 AS invdefine_3
    ,InvP.cInvDefine4 AS invdefine_4,InvP.cInvDefine5 AS invdefine_5
    ,InvP.cInvDefine6 AS invdefine_6,InvP.cInvDefine7 AS invdefine_7
    ,InvP.cInvDefine8 AS invdefine_8,InvP.cInvDefine9 AS invdefine_9
    ,InvP.cInvDefine10 AS invdefine_10,InvP.cInvDefine11 AS invdefine_11
    ,InvP.cInvDefine12 AS invdefine_12,InvP.cInvDefine13 AS invdefine_13
    ,InvP.cInvDefine14 AS invdefine_14,InvP.cInvDefine15 AS invdefine_15
    ,InvP.cInvDefine16 AS invdefine_16,UnitP.cComUnitName AS invunitname
    ,InvC.cInvAddCode AS dinvaddcode,InvC.cInvName AS dinvname
    ,InvC.cInvStd AS dinvstd,InvC.cComUnitCode AS dinvunit
    ,UnitC.cComUnitName AS dinvunitname,WH.cWhName AS dwhname
    ,Dept.cDepName AS ddeptname,InvC.cInvDefine1 AS dinvdefine_1
    ,InvC.cInvDefine2 AS dinvdefine_2,InvC.cInvDefine3 AS dinvdefine_3
    ,InvC.cInvDefine4 AS dinvdefine_4,InvC.cInvDefine5 AS dinvdefine_5
    ,InvC.cInvDefine6 AS dinvdefine_6,InvC.cInvDefine7 AS dinvdefine_7
    ,InvC.cInvDefine8 AS dinvdefine_8,InvC.cInvDefine9 AS dinvdefine_9
    ,InvC.cInvDefine10 AS dinvdefine_10,InvC.cInvDefine11 AS dinvdefine_11
    ,InvC.cInvDefine12 AS dinvdefine_12,InvC.cInvDefine13 AS dinvdefine_13
    ,InvC.cInvDefine14 AS dinvdefine_14,InvC.cInvDefine15 AS dinvdefine_15
    ,InvC.cInvDefine16 AS dinvdefine_16,unitCA.cComUnitName AS dauxunitname
    ,GroupC.cGroupCode AS dgroupcode, GroupC.iGroupType AS dgrouptype 
    ,Rout.[Description] AS dopdesc
    ,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(BomP.InvCode, '') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS bexist

  --region 增加母件、子件自由项,id
    ,PDM.cpfree1,PDM.cpfree2,PDM.cpfree3,PDM.cpfree4,PDM.cpfree5,PDM.cpfree6
    ,PDM.cpfree7,PDM.cpfree8,PDM.cpfree9,PDM.cpfree10
    ,PDM.ccfree1,PDM.ccfree2,PDM.ccfree3,PDM.ccfree4,PDM.ccfree5,PDM.ccfree6
    ,PDM.ccfree7,PDM.ccfree8,PDM.ccfree9,PDM.ccfree10,PDM.id
  --endregion
FROM pdm_bom_bom PDM 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN Inventory InvP ON PDM.invcode = InvP.cInvCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ComputationUnit UnitP ON InvP.cComUnitCode = UnitP.cComUnitCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN Inventory InvC ON PDM.invcode_sub = InvC.cInvCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ComputationUnit UnitC ON InvC.cComUnitCode = UnitC.cComUnitCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN Warehouse WH ON PDM.whcode = WH.cWhCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN Department Dept ON PDM.drawdeptcode = Dept.cDepCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ComputationUnit UnitCA ON PDM.u_auxunitcode = UnitCA.cComUnitCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ComputationGroup GroupC ON UnitC.cGroupCode = GroupC.cGroupCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN sfc_proutingdetail SfcD ON PDM.opseq = SfcD.OpSeq 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
     (  SELECT 
            Part.InvCode, SfcD.OpSeq, SfcD.Description  
        FROM sfc_prouting Sfc 
            INNER JOIN sfc_proutingpart SfcPart ON Sfc.PRoutingId = SfcPart.PRoutingId 
            INNER JOIN bas_part Part ON SfcPart.PartId = Part.PartId 
            INNER JOIN sfc_proutingdetail SfcD ON Sfc.PRoutingId = SfcD.PRoutingId 
      ) Rout ON PDM.opseq = Rout.OpSeq AND PDM.invcode_sub = Rout.InvCode 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN 
     (  SELECT 
            BOM.BomType,Part.InvCode,BOM.[Version],BOM.IdentCode
            
            --#region lhye,2010-11-03,自由项支持
            ,part.Free1 AS cfree1,part.Free2 AS cfree2,part.Free3 AS cfree3
            ,part.Free4 AS cfree4,part.Free5 AS cfree5,part.Free6 AS cfree6
            ,part.Free7 AS cfree7,part.Free8 AS cfree8,part.Free9 AS cfree9
            ,part.Free10 AS cfree10
            --#endregion

        FROM bom_bom BOM 
            INNER JOIN bom_parent Parent ON BOM.BomId = Parent.BomId 
            INNER JOIN bas_part Part ON Parent.ParentId = Part.PartId 
      ) BomP ON PDM.bomtype = BomP.bomtype 
      AND PDM.invcode = BomP.invcode 
      AND PDM.u_versionhandle = 1 
      AND ISNULL(PDM.[version], 0) = ISNULL(BomP.[version], 0) 
      AND ISNULL(PDM.u_identcode, '') = ISNULL(BomP.identcode, '')
      
      --#region lhye,2010-11-03,自由项支持
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree1, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree1, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree2, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree2, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree3, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree3, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree4, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree4, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree5, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree5, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree6, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree6, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree7, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree7, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree8, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree8, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree9, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree9, '')
      AND ISNULL(PDM.cpfree10, '') = ISNULL(BomP.cfree10, '')
      --#endregion

create view [除取消外零件编号最小和最大工序号] as SELECT
  零件编号,
  MIN ( [流水工序号] ) AS 最小工序号,
  MAX ( 流水工序号 ) AS 最大工序号
FROM
  [dbo].[生产工序信息_主表] 
WHERE
  [工序状态] not in( '取消','报废') 
GROUP BY
  零件编号
